criteria_outcomes.criterion: preserve exact handoff needs and allowed record identifiers
avoid generic keyword matches or unrelated candidates
leave missing capability evidence visible as unsupported

reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage correctly preserves the eight allowed record identifiers and maps only exact need strings present in capabilities to direct coverage, leaving n06-r01 and n06-r07 unsupported. No generic or unrelated matches are visible in the supplied package.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: rank unsupported needs before covered needs
use upstream provenance rank as primary ordering within each group
preserve missing or contradictory evidence visibly

reviews.decision_reason: prioritize_needs inverts the unsupported flag: direct coverage rows are marked unsupported=true and are sorted ahead of genuinely unsupported rows. This contradicts the declared role to rank unsupported needs before covered needs and makes the priority table semantically wrong even though the final recommendation string happens to match the deterministic expectation.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: construct recommendation from already-ranked first priority record

reviews.decision_reason: synthesize_recommendation performs the declared downstream operation on the priorities it receives: it retains the explicit eight-item window and constructs the recommendation from the already-ranked first priority record. The bad top record is inherited from prioritize_needs, not introduced here.
